instruction: I'm customizing my academicpages.github.io homepage. In ~/Code/Website/academicpages.github.io/_config.yml, please update the Google Scholar URL to "https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=ABC123DEF" and set the ResearchGate field to "https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Emily_Chen5".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task updates academic profile links under author. Both are nested fields representing URLs. Uses existing check_json metric.
metadata.verification_notes: Uses existing check_json metric from metrics/general.py with is_yaml=true option. All YAML keys verified to exist in _config.yml structure. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: updating googlescholar and researchgate URLs
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure file changes are persisted
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly fetches the YAML config file from VM to local cache
Metric (check_json) correctly parses YAML format with is_yaml=true option
Both nested keys are correctly navigated: ['author', 'googlescholar'] and ['author', 'researchgate']
Expected values match instruction requirements with exact equality check (method: eq)
Complete coverage: all requirements in instruction are verified by evaluator
Data flow is semantically correct: postconfig saves → getter fetches → metric parses and validates

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
